title: The Shepherd is Struck and the Sheep Scattered
description: The Lord of hosts commands the sword to wake against his shepherd, the man who stands close to him. When the shepherd is struck, the sheep are scattered, and the Lord turns his hand against the little ones. Two-thirds of the people in the land shall be cut off, but one-third shall remain. This third part the Lord will bring through the fire; he will refine them as silver is refined, and test them as gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will answer them: 'This is my people.' And they will say: 'The Lord is my God.'
